name: Mamotte Agechau!
source:
Main character returns from a part-time job by train when he sees a drunk bounded woman alongside a shady man. Protagonist steps up for the woman, and after a fight shady man jumps out of the wagon when train stops. Girl turns out to be his former sempai at school. She invites boy to a meal in gratitude for help. During the dinner old feelings bloom, and and absolutely drunk life begins in a nearby hotel.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公打完工乘电车回家时，看见一名醉得站立不稳的女性和一个可疑男子待在一起。他上前保护女子，与对方发生冲突；列车停靠后，可疑男子跳出车厢逃走。女子竟是主人公学生时代的学姐。为感谢相助，她邀请他一起吃饭。席间，昔日情愫重新萌发，随后两人在附近酒店开始了一段醉意朦胧的时光。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
